overview_description.description: Founded in 2012 and based in Dubai and Amman, Babil Games became part of Stillfront Group AB, listed on First North Premier Growth Market in Stockholm, in 2016. Babil Games helps developers from around the world to successfully navigate international markets, with a focus on the MENA region, the world’s fastest-growing games market, and bring gamers culture-adapted, high-quality entertainment in their native tongue. Babil’s success stems from its passionate, creative, high-spirited, and dedicated team of talented artists and experienced professionals. Within a few months of the release of its first game, Nida Harb, Babil Games ranked in the Top-10 on iOS App Store for its outstanding strategy-action game.

product.name: Mobile Game Publishing
product.description: Publishing mobile games tailored for the MENA region, including localization, cultural adaptation, and live operations to engage local players.

product.name: Localization and Culturalization Services
product.description: Adapting game content, visuals, messaging, and features to align with the cultural and linguistic nuances of the MENA region.

product.name: Marketing and User Acquisition
product.description: Executing marketing campaigns and user acquisition strategies to increase game visibility and player base in the MENA region.

product.name: Community Management and Customer Support
product.description: Managing player communities with customer support, engagement activities, and personalized attention to high-value players.

product.name: Technical Support and Quality Assurance
product.description: Providing technical assistance including SDK integration, bug fixes, system monitoring, and testing to ensure game stability and performance.
